basics.name: Japheth Kimeu
basics.label: Geospatial Technical Advisor
basics.summary: I am a Geospatial Technical Advisor with over 10 years of experience applying earth observation, GIS, and AI to conservation, nature-climate solutions, and climate-smart agriculture across Africa. I currently serve as a Geospatial Technical Advisor at FAO and as GIS & Data Specialist at Connected Conservation Foundation.

work.company: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)
highlights: Serving as lead geospatial advisor on the SoilFER project, overseeing soil sampling design, spatial data collection, and National Soil Information System (NSIS) development.

Developing a three-tier Decision Support System (DSS) providing advisory outputs at national level (policy and land use planning), regional level (extension services through nutrient budget maps, crop suitability maps, and soil property maps), and local level (farmer-facing advisory via SMS and the FerSIS app).
Leading national land cover mapping and generation of a national land cover legend to support soil-landscape characterisation.

Strengthening the capacity of government agencies and stakeholders including DRSRS and KALRO through targeted training on digital soil mapping, land cover assessment, and soil information systems — enhancing their ability to access, interpret, and apply spatial data in agricultural planning and decision-making.

Producing a suite of technical reports, thematic maps, and knowledge products covering crop suitability, land cover, and digital soil mapping to facilitate information sharing and evidence-based engagement with national and regional stakeholders.

work.company: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)
highlights: Led geospatial analysis and earth observation in support of food security monitoring, climate-smart agriculture, and natural resource management across Somalia.
Conducted forest and deforestation mapping using multi-temporal satellite imagery to support environmental monitoring and reporting.
Designed and delivered capacity development programmes for Somali line ministry staff and Information Management Centres on GIS, remote sensing, and spatial data management.
Managed spatial data systems, web-based geoportals, and thematic map production for FAO SWALIM partners and stakeholders.
Coordinated with government agencies, UN partners, and NGOs to define spatial data needs and contribute to national information management frameworks.
Lead geospatial analysis and earth observation work across a portfolio of critical wildlife corridors and conservation landscapes in Africa.
Apply AI/ML and very high-resolution satellite imagery to biodiversity monitoring, habitat change detection, and invasive species mapping.
Support the Interconnected Earth programme, designing spatial frameworks for ecologically linked landscape conservation across multiple sites.
Develop capacity development programmes for conservation practitioners on GIS, remote sensing, and spatial data tools.
Collaborate with the Airbus Foundation and conservation partners on imagery access, analysis pipelines, and programme design.
Serve as lead judge on the Satellites for Biodiversity Award, evaluating innovative uses of satellite data for conservation outcomes.

work.position: Senior GIS and Remote Sensing Officer
highlights: Led development and maintenance of spatial data repositories, geo-databases, and web-based portals for data dissemination.
Designed and deployed geospatial applications and dashboards using ArcGIS, QGIS, Python, Power BI, and JavaScript.
Analysed remote sensing imagery to map land use change, wetland degradation, and drought conditions using Google Earth Engine and ENVI.
Supervised and trained staff on GIS analysis, remote sensing, and spatial data management.
Collaborated with the National Land Commission and other agencies on county land information management systems.
Developed GIS and earth observation tools for mapping environmental change, land use, biodiversity, and food security.
Collected and processed spatial data from UAV, satellite imagery, and LiDAR sources alongside field surveys.
Built image classification and analysis workflows using Python, R, and machine learning methods.
Trained staff and partners on natural resource data collection and geospatial analysis.
Collaborated with NGOs and government bodies to support natural resource management policy.

advisory.role: Lead Judge, Satellites for Biodiversity Award
advisory.summary: Evaluating innovative applications of satellite earth observation for biodiversity conservation outcomes across Africa and beyond.

Moderated a high-level plenary on AI and digital tools in agriculture, bringing together panelists from across the public, private, and development sectors to examine institutional and financial barriers to technology adoption in African food systems.
Discussing the role of earth observation and AI in advancing conservation outcomes across Africa's critical wildlife corridors and landscapes.
